title: Order cancellation rate in 2024
prompt: Ops wants to know: what share of orders placed in 2024 ended up cancelled?
metricDefinition: cancelled orders / total orders, for orders placed in 2024.
referenceSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'cancelled')::DOUBLE / count(*) AS cancellation_rate FROM orders WHERE order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2025-01-01'

commonWrongAnswers.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled' AND order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
commonWrongAnswers.whyWrong: Returns the cancelled count, not the rate — without dividing by all 2024 orders you can't tell if that's a lot or a little.
